# Tough As Nails

<div class="mod-page-icon" markdown="1">

![](../../assets/mods/toughasnails.png)

</div>

Body temperature, climate hazards and armour materials for hot and cold voyages.

Installed build `9.2.0.171`. [Browse all mods](index.md).

## Pack guides

- [Weather and climate · Island climate and body temperature](../../world/weather.md#island-climate-and-body-temperature)
- [Survival at sea](../../world/survival.md)

## Effects

| In-game name | ID | In-game description |
| --- | --- | --- |
| Climate Clemency | `toughasnails:climate_clemency` | Neutralizes body temperature for the duration. Only granted temporarily when creating a new world (Or when respawning if enabled in the config). |
| Ice Resistance | `toughasnails:ice_resistance` | Grants immunity to freezing damage. |
| Internal Chill | `toughasnails:internal_chill` | Provides a slight decrease in body temperature for the duration. Will not cause hypothermia. |
| Internal Warmth | `toughasnails:internal_warmth` | Provides a slight increase in body temperature for the duration. Will not cause hyperthermia. |
| Thirst | `toughasnails:thirst` | Lowers thirst at a faster rate than normal. |
